reason: I already have my supplement and I reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. A foil sachet every day is a lot of packaging to throw away, and a gym bag does not need that.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is more trash, and I already take something I like. Why would I swap?
would_change_my_mind: A bottle or refill option with less packaging at a clearly lower price per day than what I buy now.
